id: title:EDsCODE:evaluate trino backfill flag remotely in dagster

observations.code_quote: # Dagster runs without POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY, so the client cannot load flag definitions there. A
observations.behavior: Removes `only_evaluate_locally=True` and adds a comment explaining that Trino-based Dagster workers lack API keys required to evaluate feature flags locally.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes behavior of warehouse-backed backfill execution; previously it could not use cached or evaluated flags, now it explicitly disables local evaluation while retaining its own fallback mechanism.

observations.behavior: Disables local-only evaluation mode in the feature-flag helper used during warehouse ingestion.
observations.posthog_connection: This change removes an explicit opt-out of distributed/remote evaluation for this specific path, potentially allowing more complete flag support if other parameters permit it.

observations.code_quote: # Dagster runs without POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY, so the client cannot load flag definitions there. A
observations.behavior: Adds explanatory documentation about why local evaluation is disabled in this context (missing personal API key).
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies operational constraints rather than changing implementation, but does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit.

observations.limitations: Only one hunk provided; no tests, configuration changes, or wider dependency updates are visible. No evidence of actual failure recovery, compatibility checks, or end-to-end validation.
